brief: Reads a text without changing it: a character by position, the first, last or middle, the n first or last, the characters, n-grams.
detail: Build one with new stzStringGetter("text"); it only reads, so a stzString passed in is never emptied. Positions count from 1 and in characters, so Hebrew, Arabic and emoji are read by letter. NFirstChars and NLastChars refuse a count outside the text, while NthChar forgives position 0 and a position past the end. CharNgrams and WordNgrams answer the runs of n characters or n words. BytesPerChar answers a text such as "1 4 2". NLeftChars and NRightChars should swap sides for right-to-left text and do not today, because the direction test answers TRUE for it.
